24.original: Defeat the Nu Mou porxienappers in Sextuplet Shallow.

48.original: Well, favorite mortal, we <hex:021A020203>could<hex:021A020103> be frolicking with porxies in dreams right now. But nooo! Those awful, nasty lawless ones just had to go and make off with the one I ordered from Pla Enni, so both I <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> the dreams are...porxieless!

49.original: Ugh! Ugh, I say! Oooh, when I get my hands on those porxienappers...

50.original: Wait! I don't need to get my hands on them! Because we have your much larger hands! Good, good. Go and punch a porxienapper in the face for me, mortal!

51.original: The porxie is considerably calmed by your ministrations. After sparing you an affectionate snort, it turns toward Lydha Lran.

52.original: Safe and sound! And round! And cute! Exactly what I was hoping for! I can spin the loveliest of dreams with a porxie so charming...

53.original: <sigh> But first I suppose I should inform the Nu Mou in Pla Enni that it arrived safely after all. They were so very <hex:021A020203>anxious<hex:021A020103> about it. Some fae really need to learn to calm down, if you ask me...
